title: The Causal Detective
subtitle: Evidence is immutable. Inference is not.
description: A fictional locked-room mystery where canonical-JSON SHA-256 evidence frames support forkable suspect theories and exact-hash causal conclusions.
claim: Immutable evidence frames can support multiple named interpretations while a deterministic causal oracle accepts only conclusions whose exact earlier hashes jointly satisfy person, object, location, lifecycle, and chronology.
invariants: Every evidence, theory, conclusion, and mutation frame is hashed with Web Crypto SHA-256 over recursively canonicalized JSON.
Every non-genesis frame records an exact predecessor hash and every cited cause resolves to an earlier known frame.
Competing theory forks share the immutable evidence head and never rewrite canonical observations.
A conclusion is accepted only when all five causal roles cite the exact supported evidence hashes.
Duplicate evidence use, unsupported conclusions, and semantically impossible transitions are rejected independently of cryptographic validity.
positive_path: Replay the ten canonical evidence frames and inspect their complete hashes and canonical JSON.
Connect exact earlier hashes for person, object, location, lifecycle, and chronology.
Mint the supported Mara Voss accusation and observe both cryptographic and causal assertions pass.
Fork two suspect theories and compare their shared facts with divergent interpretations.
failure_path: Append and correctly rehash a forged clue placing Elias Finch in the Violet Map Room during his unbroken North Terrace alibi; cryptographic validation remains green while the causal transition oracle turns red. Reused evidence and unsupported accusation combinations are also rejected.
features: live assertions and full frame ledger
